templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from overview-with-inset by the note-writer: a plain microarchitecture block diagram (its own corpus label pipeline), storage feeding a scheduler, with an inline eligibility-mask icon, but no magnified callout connected by dashed leaders.
templates.what_to_learn: The transferable move is pipeline's: draw the concrete bit pattern (1-1-1-0) the mechanism evaluates right next to the step that reads it, but connect it with a line to the specific queue slots it filters and vary the shade of same-coloured boxes, since near-identical orange boxes here need label-reading to tell apart.

templates.why_chosen: High-confidence rank-25 microarchitecture floorplan: a blue on-chip storage block sits above the orange scheduler and load-balancer cluster, with a worked 1-1-1-0 eligibility mask drawn directly on the FEO block instead of only in prose.
templates.what_to_learn: Annotate a worked example value, like an eligibility bitmask, directly on the block that consumes it rather than leaving it only in prose, and colour the storage box and scheduler sub-blocks by role; draw an explicit line from the mask digits to the queue slots they filter, which this figure leaves implicit.
